transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you. Um... well, I guess I'm just here because I keep messing up little things. Just... making small mistakes. Like writing down the wrong time on a class sheet over at the senior center. Or, you know, measuring a board and still cutting it a hair short because I skipped over the small print. Just... things like that.
How long have you been noticing these types of mistakes occurring?

Um... I suppose it's been getting in the way for... well, a little over a year. We moved into a condo about a year and a month ago. I started noticing it more right around then. Just... since the move, really.
Have you noticed any difficulty with your memory, such as forgetting recent conversations or where you placed your belongings?

I suppose... yeah, I do misplace things. Um. I spend more time than I probably should hunting around for my keys. Or my reading glasses. Tape measure... the little bag of supplies for my card games. It's... well, I'll have them right in my hand just a few minutes before, and then I don't know where I put them. So... yeah. Just things like that.
Aside from these memory lapses, have you been feeling a persistent sense of sadness or a loss of interest in the hobbies you usually enjoy?
Um... no. Not really. I'm not... sad. And I still like my card games and woodworking. It's just... the mistakes. That's all.
Do you find yourself feeling physically restless, tense, or unable to relax when you are trying to complete these tasks?

Well... I don't know about tense. But... I suppose if I have to sit through a whole meeting somewhere, or even just a quiet evening at the condo... I do get this sort of... ants-in-my-pants feeling. I just want to get up and check on something. Or just... putter around a bit. So... yeah, maybe a little restless.
Looking back at your younger years, did you often feel that same restless 'ants-in-my-pants' feeling or struggle with these types of mistakes when you were in school?

Well... yeah, I guess. I mean, even back in elementary school... my teachers used to write on my report cards that I was bright, but... I'd forget my books, or lose my homework. And... I'd just stare out the window a lot, unless someone was right there keeping me on track. So... yeah, it's been a while.
